// logged-out redirect needs the FULL URL a marketing "Deploy" button sent a
  // visitor to (e.g. `/dashboard/deploy?product=game&family=valheim&tier=...`,
  // see lib/deploy-intent.ts) so it can send them to `/login?next=<that URL>`
  // instead of a bare `/login` that drops the selection the customer already
  // made. Kept separate from `x-pathname` rather than folded into it so every
  // existing exact-pathname comparison (`pathname === "/admin/login"`, etc.)
  // keeps working unchanged.
  requestHeaders.set("x-search", req.nextUrl.search);

  // The new marketing site (app/nxm) at the real URLs — the launch switch.
  // With NXM_ROOT=1 every URL it owns (app/nxm/_data/live-routes.json, from
  // scripts/nxm-live-routes.ts) is served from app/nxm, and any /nxm/<route>
  // link left over from staging 301s to its real URL. Unset NXM_ROOT and
  // restart to roll back to the old marketing pages instantly — they're
  // untouched. Main host only; admin/staff hosts returned above.
  if (process.env.NXM_ROOT === "1" && !isAdminHost && !isStaffHost) {
    if (pathname === "/nxm" || pathname.startsWith("/nxm/")) {
      if ((req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD") && !/\.[a-z0-9]{2,5}$/i.test(pathname)) {
        const url = req.nextUrl.clone();
        url.pathname = pathname.slice(4) || "/";
        return NextResponse.redirect(url, 301);
      }
    } else if (NXM_EXACT.has(pathname) || NXM_PATTERNS.some((re) => re.test(pathname))) {
      const url = req.nextUrl.clone();
      url.pathname = pathname === "/" ? "/nxm" : "/nxm" + pathname;
      const res = NextResponse.rewrite(url, { request: { headers: requestHeaders } });
      // Anonymous mod pages may be cached by a shared cache / revalidated cheaply (lib/seo-cache.ts); never when a session cookie is present.
      const cc = anonModCacheControl({ method: req.method, pathname, search: req.nextUrl.search, cookie: req.headers.get("cookie"), authorization: req.headers.get("authorization"), sessionCookieName: process.env.NXEON_COOKIE_NAME ?? "nxeon_session" });
      if (cc) { res.headers.set("Cache-Control", cc); res.headers.append("Vary", "Cookie"); }
      return res;
    }
  }
  return NextResponse.next({ request: { headers: requestHeaders } });
}

  const qs = new URLSearchParams();
